## Implementation Plan (auto-approved, autonomous mode)

### Sub-tasks:
- ST-1: Refactor NoPtyProcess to merge stdout+stderr via mpsc channel (standard)
- ST-2: Update/add unit tests for stderr capture (light)
- ST-3: Review integration tests for stderr assertions (light)
- ST-4: Update documentation — job-management.md, architecture.md, storage.md (light)

### Execution order:
Wave 1: ST-1
Wave 2: ST-2, ST-3, ST-4 (parallel)

### Approach:
Thread-per-stream with std::sync::mpsc channel merging. Two background threads read stdout and stderr respectively, send chunks into shared channel. NoPtyProcess::read() receives from channel with leftover buffer for oversized chunks.

---
*Posted by nightly autonomous run*
